description: This file defines the EmployeeGender class, a filter field used within the reporting module of the OrangeHRM system. It adds specific filtering logic based on employee gender, including generating query conditions and normalizing gender values for reports.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees by gender within the reporting system.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a gender filter condition to the query builder if the operator is equality and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in the query, in this case ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the gender filter value into an array with id and label, mapping '1' to 'Male' and others to 'Female'.
